creator: Alexander Terp
description: Pane terminal modes (kitty keyboard, bracketed paste, mouse reporting) live in the daemon's VT and are not replayed in the frame stream, so surfaces cannot encode input. Candidates: daemon-side encoding (send-keys style API) or adapter-side encoding from exposed mode state (may need an upstream herdr PR - their own TUI client reports maximal key info and lets the server encode). Test kitty protocol, IME, AltGr, mouse, paste. Stage-1 gate: no faithful input path means the architecture fails.
title: Input path: prove daemon-side-correct encoding
